A.question: ¿La ausencia de bloqueo por fichero en append_private_jsonl permite intercalar fragmentos si os.write entrega una escritura parcial y hay capturas concurrentes?
A.target: serialización de una línea JSONL entre procesos cooperantes en POSIX
A.acceptance: Añadir flock exclusivo durante _write_all + fsync; prueba determinista de concurrencia sintética con escrita fraccionada, preservando rechazo de symlinks y filesystem modes.

rivals: O_APPEND basta en todos los casos para escritura compuesta (no garantizado si _write_all emite varias syscall)
File lock prevents cooperative writers from interleaving even when one line requires two os.write

C.plan: Add POSIX fcntl.flock exclusive only inside append_private_jsonl after permission checks, while retaining O_NOFOLLOW/O_APPEND/fsync; add concurrent 12-writer synthetics test splitting _write_all in 2 chunks. Run isolated POSIX snippet locally and record bounds.

D.falsifier: After lock, any of 12 JSONL lines missing/corrupted/duplicated or path symlink safety weakened.
D.limits: flock advisory only, trusted POSIX callers required; cannot make ledger append crash-atomic or guarantee unrelated writers, do not claim production durability.
